translations.web: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”
translations.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
translations.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
translations.asv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified.
